Sandbox_MinidoracatTesla_RangeMultiplier:
How far a full battery drives.
1.0 = as far as a full tank in a vanilla car of the same class; 2.0 = twice as far.
Vanilla Gas Consumption scales it too: 2 = half as far; 0 = driving uses no charge.
Sandbox_MinidoracatTesla_ChargeSpeedMult:
1.0 = official charger power (Wall Connector 11.5 kW, Mobile Connector 7.6 kW)
2.0 = twice as fast.
Sandbox_MinidoracatTesla_ChargeFuelMulti:
Generator fuel a Tesla burns: the charge, and the car's climate and Camp Mode while plugged in. Grid power is free.
1.0 = about one tank to charge a Model Y from empty to full at the default Generator Fuel Consumption; 0.5 = half; 0 = no fuel.
Generator Fuel Consumption scales it too.
Sandbox_MinidoracatTesla_CampMinBattery_:
Camp Mode cannot be turned on below this charge and turns off when the battery drops under it.
Like the real car's Low Power Mode: 10–20%%, default 20.
Sandbox_MinidoracatTesla_BluetoothRange: App Bluetooth range after power cut (tiles)
Sandbox_MinidoracatTesla_BluetoothRange_:
While the grid is up, the phone app reaches the car at any distance. After the power goes out it is Bluetooth only: the app reaches the car within this many tiles (1 tile = 1 m). 0 = no link once the power is out.
Summon is also limited by AutoDrive's Summon range (tiles) and the game's vehicle physics range of about 64 tiles; the smallest applies.
Default 50.
